caption: Step 4 of the setup wizard: paid leave preset to 25 days per year with yearly accrual and carry over allowed, before we changed anything.
Step 6 of the setup: the switch 'Send the invitations when the workspace is created' is on by default; our own name is hidden.
The same step with the invitation switch off: the note under it still says 1 invitation will go out in your name; our own name is hidden.
Adding a member by hand: the Role field shows 'Select role' with Admin, HR, Approver and Employee and nothing preselected; the account name is hidden.
Review step of Add a member: a plain Create button next to the main Create & Invite button, with 2 warnings that do not block creating; the account name is hidden.
CSV import mapping: 6 of 7 columns mapped, the employeeCode column stays on 'Skip this column' because there is no field to map it to.
Import preview: 'Permanent' is rejected; the tooltip says contract type must be one of permanent, fixed_term, intern, contractor, part_time, apprenticeship.
Import preview: the role 'Employee' is flagged and the choices are Default, Approver, HR and Admin, so the form's Employee role is called Default here.
Billing during the trial: 'You're on the free trial', 30 days left, 3 total members, with the Professional and Premium plan picker below.
